import ctypes, os, time
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/lib/libcrypto.dylib')

data = os.urandom(40*1024*1024)
out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(data))

lib.EVP_chacha20.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

ctx = lib.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new()
cipher = lib.EVP_chacha20()
iv = (1).to_bytes(4,'little') + nonce
kbuf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(key, 32)
ivbuf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(iv, 16)
lib.EVP_EncryptInit_ex(ctx, cipher, None, kbuf, ivbuf)
outl = ctypes.c_int(0)
t0=time.perf_counter_ns()
lib.EVP_EncryptUpdate(ctx, out, ctypes.byref(outl), data, len(data))
t1=time.perf_counter_ns()

""}
